newsitem.title: USA: Conversion to merge with Octagon.
newsitem.headline: Conversion to merge with Octagon.

text.p: Conversion Technologies International Inc and Octagon Inc said in a joint statement on Monday they had entered into a tentative merger agreement.

Under the terms of the proposed merger, the holders of Octagon common stock will receive one share of Conversion Technologies common stock for every ten shares of Octagon common stock, Conversion said.
Conversion Technologies said Harvey Goldman will remain as president, chief executive officer and chairman of Conversion Technologies.

William Amt, Octagon chief executive, and Harry Christenson, Octagon chief financial officer, will assume the roles of chief operating officer and chief financial officer, respectively, of Conversion Technologies, the company said.
The transaction is subject to a number of significant conditions, including the execution of a definitive merger agreement and approval of Octagon's shareholders.
Conversion Technologies is an early-stage advanced materials company making specialty products employed in industrial applications and construction materials.
Octagon is a technical services firm providing radiological control and operations and maintenance services to nuclear utilities and the Departments of Energy and Defense.
